description: Delegate a task to an independent specialist AI agent session. The delegate runs with full tool access and returns its response. Useful for breaking complex tasks into subtasks. Max depth: 3.

message.description: Task or question for the delegate agent

role.description: Role for new agent (e.g. "Solana pool analyst", "route optimizer"). Ignored if resuming session.

session.description: Existing session ID to resume, or omit to create new session

name: agent_delegate

outputSchema.description: delegate agent response (session, reply text, usage)
